lines:
Responsibilities: Presents a human-readable, JSON-free Details view for either the entire run or one selected chat block. The entire-run scope summarizes status, workflow/scope/timing, models and token usage, activity counts, and a chronological execution log. A selected block shows its breadcrumb, status/type/parent/timing, applicable model/reasoning/thinking/usage or tool fields, structured input/output, and contained child activity. A separate Raw JSON tab exposes exact redacted data for the same current scope.
Owned state: active Details or Raw JSON tab. Selection, open state, and panel width are owned by Chat Workspace; events, records, and timeline items remain projections.
Contracts: consumes ChatProjection, projected semantic timeline items, canonical runtime events, and projected run records; emits stable timeline-item selection, whole-run selection, and close intents.
Failure/degraded behavior: unavailable or redacted record values stay explicit, unknown fields use humanized labels, malformed non-serializable raw data produces a bounded message, and no hidden reasoning is inferred.
Performance/accessibility: memoized projection, complementary region, tab semantics, keyboard resizing through the workspace, breadcrumb navigation, and bounded recursive structured-value rendering.
Non-responsibilities: no event collection or retention, secret revelation, hidden chain-of-thought inference, Run mutation, or direct file opening.

Cache usage inspection (2026-09-18): Show provider-reported cached input, uncached input, reporting coverage and cache-hit ratio in model and review usage independently. A partial history or missing counters must remain explicit; do not present unknown as zero, double count alias fields, or turn token totals into invented billed costs. Durable per-call usage remains available in Raw JSON. See docs/approval-cache-accounting.md.

data.name: Run Details Inspector
data.technology: TypeScript semantic projection and accessible contextual inspector
